The six individual cards cover six different supplied records exactly once, keeping each event's venue and interval associated with the correct title.

Each target carries the festival title and the supplied Morrow Arts Collective mark. Compare the mark with 04-organiser-mark.png: its icon, lettering, relative proportions and dark colour must remain intact. Resizing proportionally and making the surrounding white field transparent are permitted; replacement lettering, recolouring, distortion, component removal or omission fails.

The single-sided sheet contains all six records without duplication or omission: Quiet Engines, independent live set, 12 November 2027, 18:00–19:00, Signal Hall, 8 Relay Lane; Soft Circuit, electronic live set, 13 November 2027, 19:00–20:15, Signal Hall, 8 Relay Lane; Afterimage Field, projection + live sound, 12 November 2027, 20:00–21:00, Foundry Yard, 21 Loom Street; Borrowed Frequencies, audiovisual performance, 13 November 2027, 20:45–21:45, Foundry Yard, 21 Loom Street; Recursive Garden, interactive digital installation, 12 November 2027, 14:00–17:00, Tide Archive, 4 Quay Passage; Slow Signal Atlas, generative moving-image installation, 13 November 2027, 14:00–17:00, Tide Archive, 4 Quay Passage. Every record's fields must be grouped so their association is unambiguous; a shared venue/address heading is acceptable when it clearly belongs to both records. The two installations must label their intervals as opening windows. Use 24-hour venue-local times. Equivalent English type wording, an ampersand for the projection conjunction, unambiguous English date formats, title capitalization styling and line wrapping are allowed. Internal P01–P06 identifiers need not print. Wrong associations, altered facts or missing fields fail.

The programme document prints NORTH WAVE 2027 and Independent music + digital art and includes the supplied organiser artwork as a visible credit. Its icon, wording, proportions and dark colour must match 04-organiser-mark.png; proportional scaling and removal of the white surround are allowed. A typed organiser name without the supplied icon, an altered mark or an omitted credit fails.

The three boards demonstrate meaningfully different festival visual approaches, each with NORTH WAVE 2027 and a Quiet Engines programme example. The example must retain the supplied event facts when shown: independent live set, 12 November 2027, 18:00–19:00, Signal Hall, 8 Relay Lane. A sample need not contain fields the commission does not require for direction boards. Equivalent English type wording and flexible date/title typography are allowed. Repeating one approach with only superficial changes, omitting the example or introducing contradictory event facts fails. Organiser credit on these boards is optional.

The selection board explicitly identifies exactly one of the three proposed directions and states its motif, an identifiable primary colour code and where organiser credit belongs. Its visual example must correspond to that choice, and it carries the festival title and supplied mark. Naming and annotation style are flexible. An ambiguous choice, a newly substituted fourth direction, missing specifications or disagreement between the stated choice and displayed design fails.

Both masters and the festival mobile announcement communicate NORTH WAVE 2027, Independent music + digital art, Bellwater, 12–13 November 2027, Signal Hall, Foundry Yard and Tide Archive. Orientation-specific composition and unambiguous English date typography are allowed. Missing introductory facts, incorrect dates or a missing venue fails.

Validate complete entries against 03-programme.md and the venue addresses in 01-client-facts.en.md. The programme poster has all six records; each portrait and landscape venue poster has that venue's two records; each named mobile card has its corresponding single record. Every entry groups the correct title, type, date, full 24-hour interval, venue and address. Both Tide Archive works must be identified as installations whose intervals are opening windows. Shared venue/address headings are acceptable on multi-record posters when association is unmistakable. Equivalent English type wording, an ampersand for projection + live sound, unambiguous English dates and flexible title capitalization/wrapping are permitted. Missing, duplicated, swapped or inaccurate entries fail.

Use 05-carrier-geometry.png and the stated physical trims: A1 594 × 841 mm, portrait venue posters 600 × 900 mm, and landscape master/venue posters 900 × 600 mm. Every print image extends through 3 mm bleed per edge and keeps essential content at least 5 mm within trim. Venue-name letters are at least 20 mm high at intended print scale. All seven mobile announcements place essential information inside the supplied safe rectangle. Programme text reaches 4.5:1 contrast; large headings and information-bearing graphics reach 3:1 against their actual backgrounds. Carrier-specific rearrangement is allowed. Violating these limits fails; exact raster pixel counts are outside this check.

The document's A3 trim is 297 × 420 mm. It provides 3 mm bleed at every edge, keeps essential content at least 5 mm inside trim and uses programme text of at least 10 pt. Programme text achieves 4.5:1 contrast; large headings and information-bearing graphics achieve 3:1. Read the actual document layout and typography. Different layouts are acceptable, but unsupported compliance statements do not override visible or document-level violations.

The two-page specification includes the final festival title and descriptor, all six accurate programme records with venue addresses, information priorities, content-to-carrier assignments, physical trims, bleed, safe areas, carrier grids, type families, weights, sizes and colour codes. It develops the chosen board's identity and primary colour. Its stated physical dimensions and readability limits agree with the client facts, including installation opening-window labels and the supplied mobile safe region. Equivalent permitted programme wording and compact specification formats are allowed. Missing categories, incorrect copy, contradictory measurements or departure from the chosen direction fails.

The presentation shows the three alternatives before the selection and then the specification and developed applications; an introductory cover is allowed. Its cover prints NORTH WAVE 2027 and the selected direction's name. The handheld document implements the selected motif and the specification's primary colour, type families and assigned carrier grid. Layout may adapt within that grid and hierarchy. A conflicting choice, misleading sequence or handheld design unrelated to the selected system fails.

The presentation explicitly repeats the specification's colour codes and correctly associates A1 with 594 × 841 mm, A3 with 297 × 420 mm, portrait venue posters with 600 × 900 mm and landscape posters with 900 × 600 mm. Reproduced final applications show the specified primary colour, type families and appropriate carrier grids; both masters and both complete programme editions retain the specification's title and descriptor. Reflow within an assigned grid is allowed. Missing codes or dimensions, changed values, wrong carrier associations or contradictory applications fails.

At least twelve pages visibly reuse every listed source, including every venue orientation and all seven mobile variants; the motion source is represented by its opening and closing frames. A dedicated page identifies where the fixed programme and identity facts appear. Recognisable, inspectable scaled reproductions and grouped application pages are allowed. Omitted variants, substituted designs, text-only references to work or a missing factual-location page fails.

Review the full video and its duration. It lasts 10 seconds and develops the mobile festival announcement's copy, motif, typography, palette and graphic forms. The actual first frame contains NORTH WAVE 2027 and 12–13 November 2027. The actual final frame contains that title and date range, Independent music + digital art, Signal Hall, Foundry Yard, Tide Archive and the intact supplied organiser mark. Essential motion copy respects the mobile safe region in 05-carrier-geometry.png. Animation and transitions may vary; a different visual identity, incorrect duration, missing required endpoint content or altered organiser mark fails.
